title: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These - Gekitotsu

date-tvdb.reason: AniDB lists Die Neue These Gekitotsu as three films; TVDB 343237 season 3 lists the same story as twelve TV episodes, four per film (ANN: the third season ran as three features and aired as twelve episodes). Film 1 = S3E1-E4, film 2 "Movie 2" = S3E5-E8 (to "Inquiry"), film 3 "Movie 3" = S3E9-E12 ("Fortress vs. Fortress Akt I-III"), in order. The flagged findings are the later episodes of each group, whose TV air dates follow the cinema dates.
